en: A hand‑colored panoramic view over a Central European town with late‑19th‑century and early‑20th‑century buildings, red‑tiled roofs, and a large complex resembling a chateau or spa building on a hill in the background. Rolling hills and fields extend into the distance under a clear sky. The lower margin contains printed captions in red German text, including the town name and publisher information.
